label: MSSP ENHANCED
aliases: \b(?:mssp|medicare shared savings program|shared savings program)(?: track)? enhanced(?: track)?\b
assumptions: Quality performance standard met (quality_score 1.0): final sharing rate 75%, loss rate 1 - 0.75 = 25% raised to the 40% floor.
MSR/MLR defaults to the variable (population-based) election; a stated MSR replaces it.
Benchmark is contract-specific and must be supplied; regional adjustment, ACPT and the risk-score cap are already inside a CMS-issued benchmark.

sharing_rate.unit: final sharing rate when the quality performance standard is met (x quality score under the alternative standard)

loss_rate_formula.value: 1 - (0.75 x quality score), not below 40% and not above 75%; 75% when neither quality standard is met

msr_schedule.unit: variable symmetric MSR/MLR by assigned beneficiaries (one of the elections)

two_sided_msr_mlr_elections.unit: symmetric MSR/MLR options, chosen for the agreement period
